newsitem.title: INDIA: India plans to buy two Russian subs -- officials.
newsitem.headline: India plans to buy two Russian subs -- officials.

text.p: India plans to import two submarines from Russia and build two more of its own, Indian officials said on Wednesday.
"There is a plan to buy two submarines and to build two more locally," a senior official told Reuters.
The Press Trust of India on Wednesday quoted the U.S. Defense News journal as saying India has agreed to a $1.5 million deal to purchase two Kilo-class diesel submarines from Russia.
But officials in New Delhi said the deal had not yet been approved by the Indian cabinet, which normally decides large defence contracts.
They also declined to say how much the total deal was worth.

The Defense News quoted Indian defence officials as saying New Delhi would release additional funds to build two HDW (Howald Swerke-Deutsche-Werft)-class submarines after the new defence budget was finalised in March.

It also quoted Indian navy officials as saying that the service had a critical requirement for new submarines as six Russian Foxtrot-class submarines would be decommissioned over the next three years.
The navy's submarine fleet now consists of six Foxtrot-class, four HDW-class and eight Kilo-class boats, PTI quoted the Defense News as saying.
The navy officials said funding problems had delayed the medium-term refit planned for the Kilo-class submarines, with at least four of them requiring normal mid-term overhaul.
